defects.what: Errors from actions on Settings and on destination pages (Extensions, Library, Projects, Automations, Archives) were invisible: the error banner was rendered only in the conversation view.
defects.fix: src/App.tsx renders the same banner on Settings and destination pages; guard test/visibleFailures.test.ts
defects.reproof: connectors probe (nonexistent and quoted) and MCP Bundle now 'refusal' with the message on the page

defects.what: Adding a curated catalog connector claimed 'configured' and counted its tools while nothing serves them.
defects.fix: connectorReachable() in src/lib/connectors.ts; catalog flag 'added'; 'Not connected' CapabilityBadge with its reason on a command-less entry; the Configured tool count only counts reachable connectors; tests in test/connectors.test.ts
defects.reproof: 'Add (curated catalog entry)' now shows Not connected and 'Configured — 4 tool(s)'

defects.what: On Windows a local MCP command whose path is quoted (needed for a path with spaces) always fails: mcp.rs spawns cmd /D /S /C with the command as one Rust-quoted argument, so the inner quotes reach cmd escaped and the server never starts ('local MCP server closed stdout before a response'). The same spawn serves the persistent start.
defects.next: on Windows pass the command with CommandExt::raw_arg inside one pair of quotes, then re-run this audit's quoted probe

notExercised: Settings > Computer use levels, 'Attach the user's browser' and 'Turn off and revoke': the profile holds an active grant (act level, attach on) and each control would change it.
Remote connector 'Reconnect' / 'Forget token' on the user's existing remote entry: it would touch a stored credential. The new-remote form was exercised instead (refused by the single-remote guard).
Share 'Copy link' (clipboard only) and Library 'Choose a file…' for import (same parser as the pasted text).
method: Effects are measured outside the click: IPC results traced on window.fetch, localStorage, a harness HTTP server's own request log, the reference share server read by a second client (node fetch), CDP targets. Folder pickers are fed with DOM.setFileInputFiles; no model turn.
